title: ISKCON leader removed over controversy surrounding midday meal program
summary: ISKCON's Vice President Radharaman Das was removed from his position amid a controversy surrounding the organization's midday meal program. The removal came after Das made comments on social media that sparked debate about the program's effectiveness and transparency. Das had posted six possible reasons for his own removal, which were later deleted. The incident has raised questions about ISKCON's governance and accountability.
summary_points: ISKCON's Vice President Radharaman Das was removed from his position
The controversy surrounds the organization's midday meal program
Das made comments on social media that sparked debate about the program's effectiveness and transparency
The removal of Das has raised questions about ISKCON's governance and accountability
Das had posted six possible reasons for his own removal, which were later deleted

summary_hi: ISKCON के उपाध्यक्ष राधरमन दास को अपनी स्थिति से हटाया गया है, जिसमें मध्यभोजन कार्यक्रम के प्रभाव और पारदर्शिता पर विवाद उत्पन्न हुआ। दास ने सोशल मीडिया पर टिप्पणी की थीं, जिसने कार्यक्रम की प्रभावशीलता और पारदर्शिता पर चर्चा शुरू कर दी।
summary_points_hi: ISKCON के उपाध्यक्ष राधरमन दास को हटाया गया है
विवाद मध्यभोजन कार्यक्रम से जुड़ा हुआ है
दास ने सोशल मीडिया पर टिप्पणी की, जिससे कार्यक्रम की प्रभावशीलता और पारदर्शिता पर चर्चा शुरू हुई
दास की हटाई से ISKCON के नेतृत्व और जवाबदेही में सवाल उठ रहे हैं
